concept.zh: 调用函数和使用返回值
concept.en: Calling functions and using their results

brief.zh: 先看补电程序里一个函数怎么调用另一个函数，再用同一个函数给两块电池各补一次电。
brief.en: Watch one function call another in the charging program, then reuse a function to top up two readings.

title.zh: 一个函数读取另一个函数的返回值
title.en: One function uses the result of another

examples.source:
def add_charge(current, extra):
    total = current + extra
    return total

def prepare_robot(current):
    extra = 3
    ready = add_charge(current, extra)
    return ready

charge = scan()
result = prepare_robot(charge)
submit(result)

title.en: Add two units to each of two batteries

examples.source:
def top_up(charge):
    charge = charge + 2
    return charge

readings = scan()
first = top_up(readings[0])
second = top_up(readings[1])
submit(first)
submit(second)
